name: Sørvágsvatn
bestView: Trælanípa cliff itself: the lake appears to float above the ocean. The full optical illusion needs you 200m back along the rim
bestMonths: May to August. Expect four seasons in one day, any day
crowd: The private-land trail takes 800 hikers a day in summer. Go before 10:00 and you share it with sheep
kid: Puffin colonies at Mykines (ferry from Sørvágur), grass-roofed villages, and weather that changes fast enough to feel like magic
priceNote: Trails on private land charge a hiker's fee in cash or card at the gate — that is normal, not a scam.

visa.note: NOT Schengen-customary: Faroe Islands have their own rules; a Schengen visa must be marked 'valid for Faroe Islands'.
